messages:
marie: Heads up — EOQ release freeze extended 48h to apply a critical infra kernel patch and investigate a canary RPS spike. Hold all non-urgent deploys. Details below.

devon: Which services are affected? Is this region-wide?

marie: Primary impact: gpu-fleet + model-router in us-west for the kernel patch. Canary anomaly observed on embeddings route in canary-2 (spike + transient OOMs).

gina: Seeing failed canaries 3/5 on canary-2, logs show KV cache thrash leading to memory pressure. Pausing canary expansion.

release-bot: Canary group 'canary-2' marked PAUSED by gina at 2025-11-04T09:12Z.

samir: Proposed action: ops roll kernel patch to one node in canary pool, validate for 30-60m, then stagger roll. @ops-oncall can you run patch validation checklist?

ops-oncall: On it. ETA ~45m. Will post the validation checklist and runtime metrics here when done.

marie: Exception process: if you need an urgent hotfix during the freeze, use:
```
/permit-deploy EOQ-KERNEL --pr <URL> --reason "hotfix for production OOM"
```
Approvers: eng-sre lead + release manager. Include rollback plan and smoke-test steps.

devon: Can we throttle some routes temporarily to reduce RPS pressure on canary-2?

gina: Yes — start with throttling embeddings (/v1/embed) and search-reorder. Suggest soft-limit to 20 req/s per token for canary-2, reduce client-side batching if possible.

marie: Internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-freeze-extend (internal). I've updated the release calendar — freeze extended until Mon 15:00 UTC. Auto-unfreeze is disabled.

release-bot: Freeze extended by 48h. New window open: Mon 15:00 UTC. Auto-unfreeze disabled.

samir: :thumbsup: I'll own post-patch canary validation and will ping here when we reach stable metrics.

ops-oncall: Patch applied to first node, 30m observation window completed with no OOMs and stable CPU. Proceeding with a staggered roll (3 nodes / 20m).

gina: Good sign. Re-enable canary expansion only after +2h of full-roll stability and a green smoke-test run. @marie please confirm gating.

marie: Confirmed. Thanks all — please escalate any regression immediately in this thread and add a quick summary to the postmortem doc after roll.
